# Third-party code in the native libraries

## jamesdsp_eel2 (Liveprog)

The EEL2 script engine with JamesDSP's extensions, taken from the libjamesdsp subtree of
[JDSP4Linux](https://github.com/Audio4Linux/JDSP4Linux) (`libjamesdsp/subtree/Main/libjamesdsp/jni/jamesdsp/jdsp/Effects/eel2`).

- EEL2 core (`nseel-compiler.c`, `nseel-ram.c`, `fft.c`, …): Cockos Incorporated and Nullsoft,
  zlib-style license, kept in each file's header.
- JamesDSP extensions and `numericSys`: James Fung (james34602), taken from JDSP4Linux's GPL-3.0
  distribution alongside `jamesdsp_eel2/LICENSE-libjamesdsp-GPL2`. Upstream JamesDSPManager ships
  GPL-2.0 text without per-file "or later" headers, so confirm upstream permission if distributing
  beyond JDSP4Linux's subtree. Some `numericSys` parts carry their own permissive or LGPL terms in
  their headers (libsamplerate BSD-2, HPA LGPL-2.1+, SolvOpt, Mersenne Twister), and `y.tab.c` is
  parser code generated by GNU Bison 2.3.
- Packaged for Linux by Tim Schneeberger (ThePBone) in JDSP4Linux and RootlessJamesDSP, GPL-3.0.

Changed for Mochy, as the zlib license asks to be marked: `nseel-compiler.c` leaves out the builtins
that touch files, folders, threads or sleep when `MOCHY_EEL_SANDBOX` is defined (see its header).
Nothing else was changed; `dirent.h` and `dr_mp3.h` were left out because nothing builds them.

## fx/reverb/progenitor (Progenitor 2)

From [sndfilter](https://github.com/voidqk/sndfilter) by Sean Connelly, MIT License, with James Fung's
changes from JamesDSP. Ported to C++ for Mochy; the full MIT notice is in `fx/reverb/progenitor.h`.

## libusb

Vendored in `third_party/libusb` for optional USB DAC pass-through (`usb_io_libusb.cpp`).
Licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1 or later (`third_party/libusb/COPYING`).

## Inspiration

The bus mixer, per-channel FX chain, reverb decay graph, and libusb USB DAC pass-through workflow
were inspired by [Tryptify](https://github.com/tryptz/Tryptify) by tryptz (GPL-3.0).

## Not here on purpose

Mochy has no Cavern code. Cavern's license adds terms (no selling, no ads) that are incompatible
with GPL-3.0. Because `dlopen` plugins loaded through `modules/api/native/mochy_fx.h` run in the
same process address space as `libmochyfx.so`, native audio modules distributed for Mochy must
also use a GPL-3.0-compatible license.
